integrity: The five-vertex counterexample is proved directly from the defining transfer condition. The critical transfer to the leaf preserves Italian domination but fails secure Italian domination. A standalone exhaustive checker verifies the target graph and all smaller simple graphs with leaves.
scientific_limitations: The finding falsifies the published leaf-normalization lemma but does not assert that downstream theorems depending on it are false.
Smallest-order status is established by exhaustive enumeration of all simple graphs on fewer than five vertices having a leaf.
A differently phrased or non-indexed correction may exist despite targeted searches.
title: A smallest counterexample to the leaf-normalization lemma for secure Italian domination
